'''Cathor Hills''' was one of many [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Forest/Legends|forests]] located on the lush [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]], homeworld of the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]]. The forest was [[Subjugation of Ithor|razed]] by Imperial [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Alima]] in a campaign to attain Ithorian technology for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
